behavior: Write deletion intent independently before physical eviction;failed eviction cannot roll it back.
Point/legacy/indexed search and backup cache collection hide pending rows;index total/order family computed after bounded128-ID reconciliation.
Preserve captured pending intents across older-backup restore and skip matching backup rows.
Older concurrent cleanup cannot retire newer intent;owner/generation/cancel checked across batch boundaries and final consumer.
Journal write failure still attempts old physical cleanup. Successful fallback returns success;double failure preserves both errors/cause.
limits: Distinct in-flight panel deleted-ID Set is still unbounded;not removed and no active-frontier memory acceptance claimed.

Source writers racing after successful eviction and backup import versus concurrent newly accepted deletion are not closed by this captured-intent preservation.
Backup collector intentionally still returns full cache array;its intent map is not a bounded whole-backup API.
